title: Plastic Container Storage
description: Clean and reuse rigid plastic containers for organizing small household goods or hardware.
steps: 1. Wash container thoroughly with soap and water; 2. Dry completely; 3. Use for dry goods or tool storage.

title: Household Seedling Planter
description: Convert plastic containers into simple nursery pots for indoor or garden seedlings.
steps: 1. Clean container; 2. Carefully pierce small drainage holes in the base; 3. Fill with soil and plant seeds.

title: Desk Stationery Organizer
description: Cut and combine plastic items into partitioned desk pencil and stationery holders.
steps: 1. Clean materials; 2. Trim top rims evenly; 3. Bind units side-by-side with tape.

title: Plastic Recycling Preparation
description: Rinse clean and flatten rigid plastic items for local curbside dry recycling collection.
steps: 1. Empty contents; 2. Rinse residue; 3. Compress container; 4. Place in dry recycling bin.
expected_output: Recyclable plastic ready for municipal sorting

title: Glass Jar Pantry Storage
description: Sterilize and reuse glass jars for storing pulses spices or non-perishable pantry items.
steps: 1. Wash jar with warm soapy water; 2. Remove label residue; 3. Air dry and fill with dry ingredients.

title: Decorative Floral Vase
description: Repurpose clean glass containers as tabletop floral vases or propagation vessels.
steps: 1. Clean glass thoroughly; 2. Fill halfway with water; 3. Place plant cuttings or fresh flowers.

title: Glass Candle Holder or Planter
description: Transform sturdy glass containers into indoor succulent planters or tealight holders.
steps: 1. Clean glass; 2. Add drainage pebbles at the bottom; 3. Add potting mix or place a tealight safely inside.
expected_output: Succulent glass planter or candle vessel

title: Glass Container Recycling
description: Clean and color-sort unbroken glass bottles and jars for municipal recycling drop-off.
steps: 1. Rinse food or liquid residue; 2. Remove metal lids; 3. Deposit in designated glass recycling bin.
expected_output: Sorted glass ready for cullet processing

title: Metal Tin Pen and Tool Stand
description: Clean sturdy metal tins and cans to hold pens paintbrushes or small workshop tools.
steps: 1. Wash and dry tin; 2. Inspect rim for smoothness; 3. Place on workbench or desk for tool holding.

title: Hanging Herb Planter
description: Make a hanging herb planter using a clean metal tin that already has suitable drainage holes and safe, finished edges. Do not punch or drill new holes into the tin.
tools: Pre-perforated metal tin, hanging twine, potting soil, herb seedling, gloves
steps: 1. Select a clean, intact tin with existing drainage holes and smooth, finished edges; 2. Reject any tin with sharp burrs, jagged rims, rust, or damage; 3. Secure the twine around the tin or through existing safe attachment points; 4. Add suitable potting soil and a small herb plant; 5. Place the planter where excess water can drain safely
expected_output: Hanging herb planter made from a clean, pre-perforated metal container
fallback: Use a ready-made planter with drainage holes if a suitable safe tin is unavailable

title: Metal and Tin Recycling Preparation
description: Rinse clean and compact metal cans and foil for municipal scrap metal collection.
steps: 1. Empty and rinse metal item; 2. Flatten if possible to conserve space; 3. Place in metal recycling bin.

title: Scratchpad and Draft Paper
description: Bind or clip blank reverse sides of printed paper for daily notes shopping lists and drafts.
steps: 1. Collect single-sided clean paper; 2. Cut to uniform notepad size; 3. Secure with a clip for scratchpad use.

title: Paper Shred Packaging Cushion
description: Shred unsoiled scrap paper into protective packing cushion for shipping delicate items.
steps: 1. Gather clean scrap sheets; 2. Cut into thin ribbon strips; 3. Use as box void fill for packaging.

title: Clean Paper Recycling Bundle
description: Keep unsoiled paper flat dry and stacked for community paper recycling collection.
steps: 1. Remove plastic tape and metal staples; 2. Keep paper dry; 3. Tie neatly in a stack for collection.
expected_output: Sorted dry paper ready for pulping

title: Cardboard Moving and Storage Box
description: Reuse sturdy corrugated cardboard boxes for household storage organization or parcel mailing.
steps: 1. Inspect box integrity; 2. Reinforce base seams with packaging tape; 3. Label and pack items.

title: Drawer Divider Organizer
description: Cut and slot cardboard panels into custom grid dividers for clothing or kitchen drawers.
steps: 1. Measure drawer dimensions; 2. Cut cardboard strips to height; 3. Interlock slotted strips to form compartments.

title: Multi-Tier Desk Organizer
description: Construct an upright multi-slot mail and document sorter from heavy cardboard panels.
steps: 1. Cut base and divider walls; 2. Glue slotted shelves; 3. Allow glue to set for 1 hour before loading documents.

title: Cardboard Flattening and Bundling
description: Flatten and tie corrugated cardboard cartons for local bulk paper recycling pickup.
steps: 1. Remove excessive tape and labels; 2. Collapse boxes flat; 3. Bundle with twine for curbside collection.
expected_output: Flattened bulk cardboard ready for recycling

title: Garment Seam and Button Repair
description: Mend loose buttons torn seams or small rips with needle and thread to restore wearable life.
steps: 1. Thread needle with matching thread; 2. Stitch torn seam with small backstitches; 3. Knot securely inside.

title: Cotton Cleaning and Dusting Cloth
description: Cut worn non-wearable cotton garments into absorbent reusable rags for dusting and cleaning.
steps: 1. Wash garment; 2. Remove zippers and buttons; 3. Cut fabric into rectangular cleaning cloths.
expected_output: Reusable household dust and wash rags

title: Tote Bag from Old Garment
description: Transform sturdy denim or cotton shirts into a reusable grocery shopping tote bag.
steps: 1. Cut off sleeves and widen collar; 2. Turn inside-out and sew bottom hem closed; 3. Reinforce handles.

title: Textile Recycling or Charity Drop-off
description: Clean and bundle garments for municipal textile recovery bins or registered charity donation.
steps: 1. Wash garments; 2. Fold and pack in bag; 3. Drop off at designated textile bank or donation centre.
expected_output: Textiles routed for donation or fiber shredding

title: Shoe Sole and Insole Refresh
description: Clean footwear thoroughly replace worn insoles or re-adhere peeling rubber edges.
steps: 1. Scrub dirt from soles; 2. Apply contact adhesive to loose sole edge; 3. Clamp tight until cured.

title: Secondary Yard Work Footwear
description: Dedicate worn but intact footwear specifically for gardening painting and heavy outdoor chores.
steps: 1. Clean exterior dirt; 2. Designate as heavy-duty utility shoes for dirty household work.

title: Shoe Recycling Drop-off
description: Drop off paired footwear at athletic shoe recycling bins or registered footwear donation points.
steps: 1. Tie laces together in pairs; 2. Place in designated shoe drop box for material recovery.

title: Designated Hazardous Battery E-Waste Drop-off
description: Safely tape terminals and drop spent household batteries into certified e-waste recovery bins. NEVER cut open heat or dismantle batteries.
steps: 1. Cover positive terminals with non-conductive tape; 2. Store in dry non-metallic box; 3. Take to certified battery drop box.
expected_output: Safe containment and specialized e-waste processing

title: Household Organic Compost Pit
description: Layer fruit vegetable and garden peelings in home compost bin for nutrient-rich garden soil.
steps: 1. Collect raw kitchen vegetable scraps; 2. Layer 1 part green matter with 2 parts dry brown leaves; 3. Turn periodically.

title: Municipal Wet Waste Collection
description: Place organic food scraps in designated segregated green wet-waste bin for municipal composting.
steps: 1. Segregate from plastics and packaging; 2. Deposit into wet waste municipal bin.

title: Non-Recyclable Residual Waste Disposal
description: Bag and dispose of contaminated non-recoverable household refuse through municipal collection.
steps: 1. Verify item cannot be safely repaired or recycled; 2. Bag securely; 3. Hand over to municipal waste service.
expected_output: Sanitary municipal landfill or energy recovery

title: Self-Watering Sub-Irrigation Bottle Planter
description: Cut bottle in half and invert top half with cotton wick into water reservoir for automated plant watering.
steps: 1. Wash PET bottle; 2. Cut horizontally around midpoint; 3. Thread cotton yarn through cap hole; 4. Invert top funnel into base reservoir; 5. Add soil and plant seedling.

title: Hanging Wild Bird Seed Feeder
description: Create feeding ports and wooden perches in a clean bottle for backyard bird feeding.
steps: 1. Wash and dry plastic bottle; 2. Cut small diamond feed ports 2 inches from base; 3. Poke holes below ports and insert twigs for perches; 4. Fill with bird seed; 5. Secure hanging twine around bottle neck.

title: Plastic Bottle Zipper Pencil Case
description: Join two plastic bottle bottoms with a zipper for a durable water-resistant stationery container.
steps: 1. Cut the bases off two plastic bottles; 2. Align zipper along inside rim of base; 3. Glue zipper tape with craft adhesive; 4. Attach second bottle base to top zipper half; 5. Allow adhesive to cure.
expected_output: Cylindrical zippered container for pencils or small tools

title: Slow-Release Root Drip Irrigation Spike
description: Pierce micro-holes in plastic bottles or jugs and bury near plant roots for garden water conservation.
steps: 1. Rinse container clean; 2. Pierce 4-6 micro-holes around lower third; 3. Bury container upright beside garden plant; 4. Fill with water and replace cap loosely.

title: Heavy-Duty Milk Jug Utility Scoop
description: Cut clean HDPE handle bottles diagonally to create durable ergonomic utility scoops for pet food or garden soil.
steps: 1. Wash container thoroughly; 2. Trace diagonal cutting line from below handle to bottom front; 3. Cut along line with craft knife; 4. Smooth cut edges with fine sandpaper.
expected_output: Ergonomic handle utility scoop for pet food grain or potting soil

title: Mason Jar Soap and Lotion Dispenser
description: Fit a standard pump mechanism through a drilled or punched jar lid to make a durable countertop soap dispenser.
steps: 1. Wash jar and sterilize lid; 2. Drill hole matching pump diameter in lid centre; 3. Insert pump nozzle and seal collar with silicone adhesive; 4. Fill jar with liquid soap and screw lid tight.

title: Decorative Mason Jar Lantern and Luminary
description: Wrap glass jars with wire handle and frost or decorate exterior for indoor/patio ambient lighting.
steps: 1. Clean and dry glass jar; 2. Wrap craft wire securely beneath neck rim to create hanging loop; 3. Place battery tealight or candle inside; 4. Hang or display safely.
expected_output: Ambient glass lantern or luminary vessel

title: Punched Tin Ambient Lantern
description: Create a lantern effect using a commercially manufactured perforated metal container with finished edges. Do not punch or hammer holes into a tin can. Use a battery-operated LED tealight.
tools: Finished-edge perforated metal container, battery-operated LED tealight, gloves
steps: 1. Select a clean, commercially manufactured perforated metal container with smooth, finished edges; 2. Reject containers with sharp burrs, jagged edges, rust, or damage; 3. Clean and dry the container according to its material; 4. Place a battery-operated LED tealight inside; 5. Check that the container is stable before displaying it
expected_output: Decorative LED lantern using a ready-made perforated metal container
fallback: Use a ready-made lantern or LED decorative holder if no safe container is available

title: Acoustic Wind Chimes from Clean Tins
description: Make wind chimes using clean, pre-perforated metal tins with finished holes. Do not punch new holes or hammer the containers.
tools: Pre-perforated metal tins with finished edges, paint, twine, wooden beads, wooden branch, gloves
steps: 1. Choose clean tins with smooth rims and existing finished holes; 2. Reject any tin with sharp burrs, jagged edges, rust, or damage; 3. Paint the exterior if desired and allow it to dry fully; 4. Thread twine through existing safe holes and attach wooden bead clappers; 5. Secure the strings to a suitable wooden branch; 6. Check all attachment points before hanging
expected_output: Wind chime made from clean, pre-perforated metal tins without creating new holes
fallback: Use ready-made metal chime pieces or another material with safe, existing openings

title: Biodegradable Newspaper Seedling Pots
description: Roll newspaper sheets around a can to form planting cups that decompose directly in garden soil.
steps: 1. Fold double sheet of newspaper into long strip; 2. Roll around small bottle or can; 3. Tuck bottom folds tightly to form base; 4. Slide off can and fill with potting soil.

title: No-Glue Origami Newspaper Gift Bag
description: Fold printed newspaper sheets into reinforced eco-friendly shopping or gift bags.
steps: 1. Lay out 2 sheets of newspaper; 2. Fold top edge over for reinforcement; 3. Fold into cylinder and crease sides; 4. Fold envelope base; 5. Punch holes and attach twine handles.

title: Toilet Paper Roll Cord and Cable Organizer
description: Label toilet paper and towel rolls to compartmentalize electrical cords and cables tangle-free.
steps: 1. Gather clean paper rolls; 2. Coil electrical cord neatly; 3. Insert coiled cable into paper tube; 4. Label tube with cable name; 5. Store standing in drawer.

title: Egg Carton Seed Starter Greenhouse
description: Use biodegradable pulp egg cartons as modular seed germination trays with moisture-retaining cover.
steps: 1. Cut off carton lid; 2. Fill individual egg cups with potting soil; 3. Plant 1-2 seeds per cup and water gently; 4. Transplant directly into garden when seedlings sprout.

title: Cereal Box Magazine and Mail Sorter
description: Cut cereal carton diagonally and wrap with craft paper for vertical book and magazine sorting.
steps: 1. Measure diagonal cut across side panels of cereal box; 2. Cut along line; 3. Cover raw edges with paper or tape; 4. Place upright on bookshelf for file sorting.

title: Corrugated Cardboard Cat Scratching Pad
description: Slice heavy corrugated cardboard into uniform strips and coil tightly or pack into shallow tray.
steps: 1. Cut clean cardboard cartons into 2-inch wide strips; 2. Roll first strip tightly into a spiral and glue; 3. Wrap additional strips around spiral until 10 inches wide; 4. Tape perimeter.

title: Interlocking Cardboard Phone and Tablet Stand
description: Cut slotted cardboard triangles to create a portable folding mobile device stand without glue.
steps: 1. Draw triangular template with angled shelf notch; 2. Cut two identical triangle supports from stiff cardboard; 3. Cut interlocking slots; 4. Assemble by slotting pieces together.

title: Braided Fabric Rope Pet Toy
description: Cut old cotton garments into long strips and weave a tight multi-strand knot toy for pets.
steps: 1. Cut t-shirt into 2-inch wide strips; 2. Knot 6 strips together at top; 3. Braid tightly into thick rope; 4. Tie oversized knot at bottom and trim ends.
expected_output: Durable washable braided pet chew rope

title: Macramé Fabric Yarn Hanging Plant Holder
description: Cut continuous t-shirt yarn and knot into a suspended plant pot hanger.
steps: 1. Cut t-shirt into 1-inch continuous yarn; 2. Cut 8 equal lengths of 4 feet; 3. Tie all strands together in bottom base knot; 4. Tie pairwise square knots to cradle plant pot; 5. Gather at top in hanging loop.
expected_output: Suspended macramé indoor plant pot hanger

title: Upcycled Denim Multi-Pocket Wall Organizer
description: Cut back pockets from worn jeans and stitch or glue onto canvas backing for wall storage.
steps: 1. Cut back pockets from worn denim pants leaving border; 2. Arrange pockets in grid on sturdy fabric backing; 3. Stitch or apply heavy fabric glue along sides and bottom; 4. Insert dowel rod at top to hang.
expected_output: Multi-pocket wall organizer for tools craft supplies or remotes

title: Wine Cork Hot Pot Trivet and Coaster
description: Slice and glue natural wine corks in a hexagonal or circular pattern for heat-resistant table trivets.
steps: 1. Slice clean corks in half lengthwise with sharp knife; 2. Sand flat edges smooth; 3. Arrange corks in concentric circle or grid on cork/felt backing; 4. Glue firmly and clamp until dry.
expected_output: Heat-resistant table mat or kitchen trivet

title: Upcycled Wine Cork Garden Plant Markers
description: Impress or write plant names on natural wine corks and mount on wooden skewers for garden identification.
steps: 1. Write herb or vegetable name on cork with waterproof marker; 2. Pierce bottom of cork with wooden bamboo skewer; 3. Insert skewer into garden bed or potting container.

title: Household Ceramic and Stoneware Adhesive Repair
description: Clean broken edges of ceramic mugs plates or planters and bond with food-safe epoxy or ceramic adhesive.
steps: 1. Clean shattered edges with rubbing alcohol; 2. Dry-fit pieces to verify alignment; 3. Apply thin bead of ceramic adhesive along fractures; 4. Press firmly together and tape until cured.
expected_output: Restored structural ceramic vessel or planter

title: Household Miscellaneous Segregation and Drop-off
description: Sort complex and multi-material household items into designated recovery streams.
steps: 1. Separate composite parts where possible; 2. Identify material markings; 3. Deposit in designated community recovery bin.
expected_output: Segregated miscellaneous items routed to specialized recovery

title: Aerobic Kitchen Scraps Bokashi or Bin Composting
description: Ferment or compost household kitchen scraps (fruit/vegetable trimmings, coffee grounds) in airtight aerated bin.
steps: 1. Collect vegetable peelings fruit rinds and coffee grounds; 2. Avoid meat dairy and oily foods; 3. Layer greens with equal parts dry brown leaves; 4. Maintain slight dampness and aerate weekly.
expected_output: Nitrogen-rich organic humus for garden enrichment

title: Citrus Peel Eco-Enzyme Household Cleaner
description: Ferment lemon orange or citrus peels with brown sugar and water in plastic bottle for natural multi-purpose cleaner.
steps: 1. Chop fresh citrus rinds into small pieces; 2. Place in bottle with 1 part sugar 3 parts peels 10 parts water; 3. Release gas daily during first month; 4. Strain liquid after 3 months for chemical-free cleaning enzyme.
expected_output: Natural bio-enzymatic surface and degreaser cleaner
source: Zero Waste Home Natural Chemistry Guide

title: Spent Coffee Grounds and Tea Soil Conditioner
description: Dry spent coffee grounds and mix directly into garden potting mix for slow-release nitrogen and drainage.
steps: 1. Collect spent coffee grounds or brewed tea leaves; 2. Spread thin on tray to air dry completely; 3. Mix into topsoil around garden plants or compost pile.
